notes.title: Suggestions on Playing Styles
notes.notes:
Suggestions on how to play:
1. Think of this game as a party game.
2. Make an appointment to play with your friends for a moment. It's better for you to open a voice chat software.
3. Copy one and go to the school computer room to play with your classmates.
(In that case, take the runtime with you, VC + + 2015, etc.)
Best of all, the people you play with are around you and can play noisily.

notes.title: North Stars 2.28 Release
notes.notes:
1.Fix the bug about the lack of character of multiplayer games.
2.Weaken Theta : Floating in the sky cost more energy.
3.Weaken Epsilon : The damage of Light Cone decreased.
Unfixed BUGs:
1.Players can join the game halfway.
Current mitigation methods: If you have choose a character in your own game , you can have a character in the game you join halfway
2.Transnational Games And Network Delay
Current mitigation methods: Before the game, check everyone's regions. Avoid international online games

notes.title: North Stars 2.27 Update!!!
notes.notes:
Key Updates:
1. [u][b]Add single player game[/b] [/u], including one story and two small games.
2. [u][b]Add lauguage option [/b][/u], now you can select Simplified Chinese or English.
3. Add words explaintion to game tutorial and something else.
4. Fix the item in the map "LightMemory".
5. Change the art of Room(Space), game settings now better than before.
6. Now the skill explaintion will automatically appear when you have choosen the character.
(that means you needn't press T)

Tip: There is still no place to tune the sound. The person who needs to tune can use the sound manager in the lower right corner of the computer.
Tip: The story has not yet been dubbed because the music maker has not yet appeared (QAQ).

Other Updates:
7. Rewrite the network system (next release starts optimization) .
8. Make the HP/EN/EX bar short and move them to the right bottom corner.
9. Fix the bug of the launcher's model.
10. Add the words of producers.
11. Add shadow for player.

notes.title: BUG report: a crash on the game
notes.notes:
After a period of testing, the reason for the crash of the game has been identified.

When someone joins in the middle of the game, the game will crash.



The current solution: limit the number of players

Future solution: I will fix the BUG to join the game halfway.

notes.notes:
I realized it after a few games.
My ID is Robert.

But more people are more fun

notes.title: Noitce of wide acceptance of player's advice
notes.notes:
I hope that  the players will offer a great deal of advice. I will be open-minded and take your advice.

Players are the first driving force of game production, hoping to perfect this game together with the players.

There is something that needs players can forgive me : I may update this game slowly, because I spend most of my time studying in school, only one day off a week, that is, I can only work one day a week. But I will try my best to make the game and fix BUGs. I will also try to get some help.

At present, there are only five members of the "凌望 production group". I am responsible for all the game productions. I will pick this load (In Chinese ,that means try hard to make it).

By master producer LT

notes.title: Announcements of advance publish of the game
notes.notes:
The master producer want players to get in touch with this game in advance, and collect data from players to help repair some BUGs. The main producer decided to release the game in June 28, 2018.
Have a happy game experience!

Please understand that this is a flawed version of the game. The problems that have been known at the moment:


1. There's a problem with the top logo in the team mode.
2. You may search for rooms that have already started playing.
3. game player scores may have problems

The master producer will try to solve these problems, and hope it will not affect your game experience too much. Now, you will be happy to achieve the original producer's original intention.

What I plan to do next: many things to do.

Best Wish！

notes.title: Keep "Free to play" Notice
notes.notes:
After making group discussion and external advice, at this stage of production group decided to maintain the "free to play" mode unchanged.
We hope to attract the masses to active groups in the world game player,
As well as providing large amounts of data to test the main producers to repair BUGs. 
Have fun！
Effects in future:
1, frankly speaking, the game producers' equipment is not very good, and there's no economy to upgrade equipment  in a short time.
2, maybe future will have DLC about DIY content which you can choose to buy.
